title: ORDER OF CREATION - Allah Created Every Thing
objectives:
1. Identify things Allah created
2. Name different plants Allah created
3. Explain the uses and importance of plants
resources: Chart showing different plants Allah created. New Revised Religious Education Textbook.
activities: Explanation, Q&A, Look and Say, Group Discussion
homework: Draw and label 3 plants that Allah created and write one use of each.
steps:
Step 1: Introduction (5 min) - Ask learners what they see around them that Allah created.
Step 2: Presentation (10 min) - Use chart to show different plants. Explain each plant and its use.
Step 3: Discussion (10 min) - Teacher asks: Why did Allah create plants? What would happen without plants?
Step 4: Group Activity (10 min) - Learners in groups name 3 plants and their uses.
Step 5: Recap (5 min) - Each group presents. Teacher summarizes.
teacher_activity: Explains the different plants Allah created using charts. Asks questions to check understanding. Guides group discussions. Summarizes key points.
learner_notes: Listen carefully to the teacher. Look at the chart and identify plants. Participate in group discussion. Present group findings to the class.
